# LMS NGCAD

> Learning Management System for Next Gen Cad Academy — manages student records, semester planning, examinations, fees, and course enrollments.

LMS NGCAD is the official Learning Management System for Next Gen Cad Academy (NGCAD). Access is limited to enrolled students and faculty; public registration is disabled.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the LMS, announcements, and examination news.
- [Login](/login): Sign in for enrolled students, teachers, and administrators.

## Optional

- [Next Gen Cad Academy](https://ngcad.org): Main academy website.
- [Fee Management System](https://fms.ngcad.org): Companion system for fee challans and billing.
